trial_backend.description: Probe speech.cpp availability without loading models.

tools.notes: speech.cpp (https://github.com/nyosegawa/speech.cpp) — MIT local TTS/ASR/VAD/diarize/enhance on ggml (Metal / Vulkan / CPU). Preferred install: `pnpm tool:setup -- --tool speech_cpp --apply` unpacks the checksum-pinned release zip into the managed env (bin/speech + libspeech). Models are fetched on first use into the OS cache (~/.cache/speech.cpp or ~/Library/Caches/speech.cpp), not into the managed env. No darwin-x64 or linux-arm64 assets in v0.10.1 (linux pin is the CPU build; use a self-built Vulkan binary via KYBERION_SPEECH_CPP_BIN when preferred). voice-actuator engine=speech_cpp and the speech_cpp STT bridge call the CLI; optional `speech serve` on loopback exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/* (KYBERION_SPEECH_CPP_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8095).
